results.title: The 2D Era Begins to End: Visual Semiconductor and INCERGO Unleash Immersive 3D Without Glasses at CEATEC 2026
results.description: TOKYO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Visual Semiconductor and INCERGO showcase five GF3D™ glasses-free 3D display categories at CEATEC 2026 in Japan.

results.title: Acer officially launches 5G tablet with 10,000 mAh battery and up to 2 TB expandable storage
results.description: Acer has launched a new 5G tablet in India with a 12.2-inch 90 Hz display and a 10,000 mAh battery. It offers 8 GB of RAM and up to 256 GB of storage, while optional bundles include a keyboard and stylus.

results.title: Data Engineering for Prize Draws: Building an Audit Trail
results.description: A practical data-engineering guide to tracing entries, handling duplicate events and preserving the records behind a prize draw result.
